There's no better feeling than the first day you unbox a new Mac and everything just works. But, as time goes on, things inevitably slow down due to age, your hard drive slowly fills up, and it simply doesn't feel as snappy as it did when you first bought it. Most people don't know what to do when this happens and either choose to live with a slow computer or erase everything and start fresh. Thankfully, there's a better option.

CleanMyMac by MacPaw is a one-click solution to help with your Mac's problems. With a single click, it can refresh your computer by removing unwanted files, optimizing startup, and running a system-wide malware scan. Sound good? You can try it risk-free with a 7-day trial by using the link below, or consider gifting it to your parent who needs a hand with their Mac but won't know where to start.

CleanMyMac by MacPaw 7-Day Free Trial

CleanMyMac helps your Mac feel brand new again by instantly removing over 20 types of "junk" files including unnecessary system files, broken downloads, hidden applications, and more, while also performing a system-wide malware scan all with a single click. It can also scan for duplicates across your system to free up additional space on your hard drive.

For Gmail users, CleanMyMac's new Email Cleanup feature can automatically remove junk mail across multiple accounts, while also freeing up your Google Drive cloud storage.

If you prefer using Google Chrome over the native Safari app for web browsing, you can enable the Browser Care Chrome extension that can monitor memory-hogging tabs and automatically close duplicate or days-old tabs to keep your computer running smoothly.

While many products claim to speed up your Mac with a single click, CleanMyMac actually delivers on that promise. It's been downloaded over 29 million times and is notarized by Apple to ensure it's safe to download and run on your computer.

You can download CleanMyMac now for any Mac running macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later with a 7-day free trial to test it out yourself.
